CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Chhattisgarh Visit Postponed Amid Delhi Protests

The two-day visit of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar to Chhattisgarh has been postponed. The CEC was scheduled to visit Chitrakote Falls and two temples. The decision to postpone the visit was made amid ongoing protests in Delhi.
